rows.name: Mercenary
rows.note: `WERoad06` (Adventurer on the Way to Nearby Dungeon): named by the alias `DisplayName` `WEMercenaryMessage` 106019; unaggressive (`WEUnaggressiveAdventurerFaction` 105D14) until a failed intimidation sets stage 95, which starts combat. Through `WEAdventurerSpellswordSubChar` 10555A.

rows.name: the drawn adventurer's race name (Nord, Orc, Redguard)
rows.note: `WERoad07` (Taunting Adventurer): he provokes the player ("What's a milk drinker like you doing out here?"); a failed intimidation or persuasion sets stage 95, which starts combat. Through `WEAdventurerWarriorSubChar` 10555B.

rows.name: the drawn adventurer's race name (Wood Elf, Argonian, Orc, Khajiit)
rows.note: `WERoad09` (Skooma Dealer): "This doesn't seem legal." or a failed intimidation sets stage 100, whose fragment calls `Dealer.StartCombat(player)`. Through `WEAdventurerBrawlerSubChar` 105563.

rows.name: Trapper
rows.note: no quest: their own factions `WEPlayerEnemy` 01DD0F (an enemy of the player) and `HunterFaction` 04E509 apply (the template flags leave out `Factions`). `Stats` from `LvlHunter` 04E50A → `LCharHunter`.

rows.name: Thug
rows.note: `WEDL05` (Thug sent by Louis Letrush): he forcegreets the player ("This is for double crossing him.") and stage 100 makes `WEDL05Faction` an enemy of the player and starts combat, unconditionally. In `WEDL06` the same record fights Louis Letrush instead.

rows.name: Madman
rows.note: `DLC2WE06` (Black Book): the alias package `DLC2WE06Forcegreet` 027A22 starts the talk, and every exit of it ("Bye." included) sets stage 100, which adds him to `WEPlayerEnemy`. `Stats` from `DLC2LCharHunter` 01F97D:Dragonborn.esm.

rows.name: Challenger

target.source: Bandits → *Common Bandits* (user, 2026-11-12): the wrappers that draw the 1–25 mook ladder are III

rows.note: `WIChangeLocation03` (Wizard Duel): he forces a magic duel on the player ("You call yourself a wizard? I challenge you to a duel!"); accepting (stage 101) and refusing (stage 100) both add him to a player-enemy faction, so he fights either way.

target.source: archetype-tiers.md §6 (user, 2026-09-27): `WEDL08DeepInHisCups` 12, his vanilla level (PC×0.9 clamped to 12–12)

rows.name: Sailor
rows.note: the Katariah crew of *Hail Sithis!* (`DB11`): `DB11KatariahCrewFaction` 0C6019 is an enemy of the player; 0C6017 carries it, the other three take `Factions` from it. `Stats` from `LCharSailor` 0C6013.

items: Bounty Hunters, Bounty Collector, Scavenger, Challenger, Old Orc: no level of their own. Each carries `Stats` from a bandit list, so the level belongs to the drawn bandit leaf, on Bandits → *Common Bandits* and *Bandit Chiefs*.
Thug: `WEDL05Thug` 0B91B0 keeps its own PC×1.15 [5–∞]. Its template `LCharBanditBossOrcM` 01B0EA lends `Traits` and `Inventory`, not `Stats`.
Deep-In-His-Cups: no template, his own PC×0.9 [12–12].

Adventurers: the nine class templates own PC×1.1 [6–∞]: `WEAdventurerBattlemage` 1034EA · `…Berserker` 105547 · `…Brawler` 10555E · `…DualPoisoner` 105549 · `…MageShieldStaff` 106113 · `…RangedConjurer` 10554B · `…Spellsword` 105540 · `…Warrior` 105541 · `…WarriorDual` 105545. The race leaves (e.g. `WEAdventurerWarriorNordF` 103503) and their Fire, Ice and Storm copies carry `Stats` from them, and every `LvlWEAdventurer*` wrapper carries `Stats` through a class sublist. `WEAdventurerTemplate` 10553F (PC×1.1 [6–45]) lends the class templates their traits and name, not `Stats`.

Trappers and the Madman: `EncHunter00Template` 073FBE owns PC×0.5 [5–15]. The `LCharHunter` and `DLC2LCharHunter` leaves carry `Stats` from it (`DLC2EncHunterNordM4` 01F97F:Dragonborn.esm through `DLC2EncHunterNordF1` 01F978). The generic hunters it also serves are not enemies (World Encounters → *Hunters*).

Sailors: `EncSailor00Template` 0C6011 owns level 1; the three `LCharSailor` leaves (`EncSailorImperialM` 0C6012 · `EncSailorRedguardM` 0C6016 · `EncSailorNordM` 088E0F) carry `Stats` from it. `LvlSailor` 0C6014 (only `SailorFaction`) is not an enemy.
The rest carry `Stats` and follow their template.
